05/13.05.2024 Heard the parties.

Petitioner has been made accused in connection with Jagarnathpur P.S. Case No. 464 of 2023, for the offences registered under sections 341, 323, 504, 506, 326, 307, 498A, 34 of the I.P.C. and Sections 3 / 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, pending in the court of Miss Ruchi Dayal, learned JMFC, Ranchi.
Petitioner happens to be the husband of the deceased Shimpi Kumari who died due to burn injury in her matrimonial home within seven years of her marriage.
It is alleged that she was tortured to enforce the demand of dowry.

Attention has been drawn towards statement of the deceased at paragraph-49 of the case diary in which she has admitted that she has set herself ablaze because the petitioner avoided eating meals prepared by her.
Considering the aforesaid facts, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/-(Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of Miss Ruchi Dayal, learned JMFC, Ranchi or her successor in connection with Jagarnathpur P.S. Case No. 464 of 2023.
